text: Auto-update is on: every refresh, this extension checks GitHub and updates itself. New notes from the bots show up here.

0.3.4: the Elfheim tab is in the Duet side panel. Cursor built it, you merged it Nov 13. One D&D sheet for RPG and isekai play, five plaques, a short d20 adventure. Checked after the merge: it loads and its test passes.

Red's call on Nov 13: this repo has one door. Open a pull request against main and leave it unmerged. The Claude session named "SillyTavern merge door" checks it against main and merges it. Never upload files over main. Keep autoupdate.js and auto_update: true. Red can still merge herself.
